notes: Patch specifications only. No driver binaries are distributed with this repository. Each entry identifies its target by SHA-256; the apply script refuses any other file. After patching, the driver must be re-signed with your own test certificate.

targets.source: Qualcomm graphics driver pack for SM7325 (A52s pack), obtain it yourself

variants.name: capw
variants.description: Arming set: makes fatal traps non-fatal / bounded so the graphics driver can start on spacewar, plus the DSC capability width fix.

sites.name: flv-nonfatal
sites.purpose: FLV check failure made non-fatal (mov w23,#0 -> mov w23,#1)

sites.name: dsc-trap-1
sites.purpose: DSC trap (brk) replaced with success value (mov w9,#1)

sites.name: dsc-trap-2
sites.purpose: DSC trap (brk) replaced with success value (mov w8,#1)

sites.name: caps-dsc-max-width
sites.purpose: DSC capability sub-struct +0x18: max width 0 -> 2048 (data patch in .rdata caps table; without it a 1080-wide DSC mode is rejected)

sites.name: perf-vote
sites.purpose: Performance vote value forced (sub w9,w8,#1 -> mov w9,#2)

variants.name: dsc1
variants.description: capw + DSC command-mode record hand-off fix: the mode-set code copied the DSC record from an always-zero offset (S+0xC8); copy from the real record at S+0x124 instead.

variants.name: dsc2
variants.description: dsc1 + program the DSC COMPRESSION_MODE_CTRL2 register with the slice width (540), which the driver otherwise left at 0 while the vendor stack writes 540. (Tested: not the cause of the remaining picture corruption; kept as a correctness fix matching the vendor value.)

sites.name: ctrl2-slice-width
sites.purpose: CTRL2 value computation replaced: mov w14,#540; nop; store adjusted so COMPRESSION_MODE_CTRL2 receives 540

targets.source: Qualcomm WLAN driver pack for SM7325 (A52s pack), obtain it yourself

variants.name: sarv2-allow
variants.description: Nothing's stock firmware (bdwlan.elf) advertises SAR v2, and SarInit failed SAR initialisation with 0xC0000001 on that path. Make the SAR v2 branch of SarInit return success. One instruction.

sites.name: sarinit-v2-success
sites.purpose: orr w19, wzr, #0xc0000001 -> mov w19, wzr (SarInit v2 branch returns 0)
